title: Repositories
notOpenable: A folder, but no project or git repository in it.
isRepository: A git repository: Enter opens it.
pathOrFilter: Filter, or a path to open
keys: ↑ ↓ to pick, Enter or a double click to open
noMatch: No recent repository matches; Enter opens the path.
forget: Remove from the list (the folder stays)
dropBefore: You can also drop a folder on this window, or run
addFolder: Add a folder you keep repositories in
noFolders: Add a folder you keep repositories in, and Haunt lists the repositories in it here.
removeFolder: Remove from the list (the folder stays)
foldersNotRead: The folders could not be read
